subject: Vulnerability closure kinetics + evidence handback for FinCore (SIG request)
messages:
From: James Turner <j.turner@fincore.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: FinCore Security <security@fincore.com>, SIG Auditor <auditor@sig.org>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Request: VM closure summary + artifacts for SIG review

Laura —

Thanks for the quick sync yesterday. As discussed on the SIG questionnaire, the auditor team needs a concise handback for our vulnerability management posture focused on the last 90 days. Specifically we need:

- A single spreadsheet listing scans (date, scanner, scope) covering Nov 1 — Nov 30, 2027.
- A CVE closure register: CVE id, severity, impacted service, remediation PR/CL link, owner, date closed, verification evidence.
- Confirmation of SLA for critical/high CVEs and any open exceptions.
- Any on‑prem evidence we can transfer to FinCore (agent logs, scan exports) — preferably a zip with a manifest.

Can you send a packet by EOD PST, or tell us the earliest ETA? Auditor would like the packet for a Friday afternoon review window.

Appreciate it —
James
James Turner
Sr. InfoSec Manager, FinCore
j.turner@fincore.com

---
Attachment requested: scan-index template (CSV)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: James Turner <j.turner@fincore.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, SIG Auditor <auditor@sig.org>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 11:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: VM closure summary + artifacts for SIG review

James — thanks for the note and clear checklist. We can provide the packet; summary below and ETA.

High level plan (deliver by today 16:00 PST):
- fin_core_scan_index_2027-11.csv — exported from our centralized scheduler, includes scanner, collection windows, and scope tags.
- cve-closure-log_2027-11-30.pdf — consolidated CVE register with remediation PR/CLs and verification steps (screenshots/scan diff snippets embedded).
- vm-scan-schedule-30-90-days.csv — next 90-day cadence plan and owner mapping.
- onprem-evidence-archive.zip — contains raw scan exports and agent logs for on‑prem nodes (manifest included).

SLA confirmation:
- Critical CVEs: 72h remediation SLA for production single-tenant services; 7 days for multi-tenant shared infra with mitigation controls documented.
- High CVEs: 14-day remediation SLA with prioritization by exploitability score.

We have one open critical exception (CVE-2027-4512) scoped to an embedded third‑party library in our on‑prem connector. Rishi will include the mitigation timeline and compensating control evidence below.

Next steps: We will drop the packet to the Drive link and share the zip via SFTP for the on‑prem artifacts. Please confirm if you prefer S3 presigned link instead.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Security Programs, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachments: fin_core_scan_index_2027-11.csv (stub), cve-closure-log_2027-11-30.pdf (stub), vm-scan-schedule-30-90-days.csv (stub)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: James Turner <j.turner@fincore.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, SIG Auditor <auditor@sig.org>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: VM closure summary + artifacts for SIG review

James / team — adding remediation specifics for the open items and verification guidance.

Summary of open/closed items (excerpt):
- CVE-2027-4512 (Critical) — impacted: onprem-connector v2.3.
  - Remediation: backport patch in repo redwood/onprem-connector, PR #2784 (link: https://git.redwood.com/onprem/PR/2784).
  - Owner: monica_patel@redwood.com
  - Remediation ETA: 2027-12-02T18:00:00-08:00 (testing + deploy).
  - Verification: post-patch scan (Nessus export) and signed test vector attached to onprem-evidence-archive.zip.

- CVE-2027-3989 (High) — container image base updates applied 2027-11-18. Verification: image digest and SBOM snapshot included in cve-closure-log_2027-11-30.pdf.

Notes on evidence and provenance:
- Each artifact in the zip has a manifest.csv with checksum (sha256) and the tool that produced it.
- We use a night‑time full scan (weekly) + incremental delta scans daily for services marked in production.
- For SIG auditors: remediation artifacts include PR link, pipeline run id, and scan diff screenshot. If you need a reproducible pipeline run id, request and we will export the run logs (obfuscated keys).

Operational SLA exceptions: the only active exception is the onprem connector due to vendor patch lag — compensating control is network isolation + ingress WAF rule in place (evidence included).

I'll upload the onprem-evidence-archive.zip to the SFTP drop at sftp://uploads.fincore.com/redwood/ and share credentials to your security@fincore.com address.

Rishi
Senior Engineering Manager, Infrastructure Security
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

---
Attachment stubs referenced: onprem-evidence-archive.zip (manifest.csv inside), fin_core_scan_index_2027-11.csv
From: James Turner <j.turner@fincore.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, SIG Auditor <auditor@sig.org>, FinCore Security <security@fincore.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 16:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: VM closure summary + artifacts for SIG review

Laura / Rishi —

Thanks, this looks good and exactly the level our auditor asked for. A few quick clarifications before we mark the packet as complete for the review: 

1) For CVE-2027-4512, can you confirm whether the backport PR also includes a signed SBOM entry? Auditor may ask for SBOM provenance.
2) For the SFTP drop, FinCore prefers S3 presigned links for ingestion into our evidence system — can you send a presigned URL instead of SFTP?

If you can reply with those two items, we’ll ingest the packet and start the SIG review. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

—James
